entry: Machine-surface repairs: the Agent Skills index digest is now generated from the artifact and drift-checked in CI, a superseded note carries its declared successor into Explore results, and the browser suite became a CI gate. Term tooltips no longer clip outside the viewport, acronyms render with their real casing, and note metadata distinguishes a note's role from its claim posture.
Added the Explore knowledge atlas and public graph endpoint; revised the editorial guide and core notes toward operationally grounded prose.
Site refactored around explicit note roles, lifecycle succession, and clearer discovery surfaces.
About page rewritten to reflect the site's expanded scope, content lifecycles, and agent-assisted authorship.
Navigable tag pages, generated per-content social cards, and accessible project terminology notes added.
Explicit note lifecycles, retrieval evaluation, an editorial-model link, and deployed revision metadata added.
Project evidence blocks, optional metadata titles, structured data, a privacy disclosure, and code-owned security headers shipped.
About page updated: name, Helsinki, professional context now lead.
Household operating platform project page rewritten with motivation section.
Project schema extended with kind field; projects index now groups by Repositories and Worlds.
sprintctl and kctl project page published.
Eight writing posts published as launch batch.
Household operating platform project page published.
